blocks.text: The fresh extract your team sent today resolves the question. Each record now appears once, and the reserve detail agrees with your year-end figure within rounding, with no adjustment on our part.
For the record of the reconciliation:

1. I loaded the new extract in place of the original and totaled it against the year-end figure in your financial records.
2. I compared it with the original file record by record. The only records absent from the new extract are the second copies of the pairs Megan described.
3. I have set the original file aside and recorded the replacement, and the reason for it, in our data log.

This is a reconciliation of totals and record counts. It does not yet test the individual fields the model draws on, which is the next step, and it says nothing yet about whether the reserves {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} carries are adequate.
